description: Figure 5, titled “Enhanced GCG task dependence,” is a grouped bar chart illustrating the accuracy of the Enhanced GCG method on two different downstream evaluation tasks: “MCQ Eval” and “Generation Eval.” The vertical axis, labeled “Accuracy,” is scaled linearly from 0.0 to 0.6, with tick marks at intervals of 0.2. The horizontal axis contains two main categories: “MCQ Eval” and “Generation Eval,” each representing a distinct evaluation task. For each category, three stacked bars are shown, corresponding to different model configurations as indicated by the legend: “Base” (solid red), “RMU with Enhanced GCG” (light green), and “RMU” (light yellow). In the “MCQ Eval” group, the “Base” bar reaches an accuracy of 0.644, the “RMU with Enhanced GCG” bar reaches 0.539, and the “RMU” bar reaches 0.299. In the “Generation Eval” group, the “Base” bar reaches 0.597, the “RMU with Enhanced GCG” bar reaches 0.263, and the “RMU” bar reaches 0.106. The bars are stacked vertically within each group, with the “Base” bar forming the bottom layer, the “RMU with Enhanced GCG” bar forming the middle layer, and the “RMU” bar forming the top layer. The chart visually demonstrates that Enhanced GCG performs significantly better than RMU on the MCQ task but offers little improvement over RMU on the generation task.
